records.issue_text: If a deletion throws at GroupTest.java:154–157, deletedAll is never set, leaving the reader thread issuing requests indefinitely.
records.rationale: The diff shows a test method where groupUuuids.forEach() at line 154-156 could throw an exception during deletion. If this happens, deletedAll.set(true) at line 157 would never execute, leaving the reader thread in an infinite loop. The code lacks a try-finally block to ensure deletedAll is set regardless of exceptions. This is a real defect in the test code introduced by this diff.
